name: Heo lang nuong
summary: Heo làng nướng, grilled village pork, is a specialty of the Mang Den weekend market, sold separately from the pork skewers and the smoked pork.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square.
seoTitle: Heo lang nuong in Mang Den
seoDescription: Heo làng nướng, grilled village pork, at the Mang Den weekend market.
